title: Document Understanding
description: Master Claude's document capabilities — upload, analyze, extract, and interact with PDFs, Word docs, spreadsheets, and more.

data.text: Claude's ability to read and understand documents is one of its most underrated features. You can upload PDFs, Word documents, text files, PowerPoints, Excel files, and images. Claude reads the content and can answer questions, summarize, extract data, compare sections, and rewrite passages — all within the same conversation.

data.title: File types Claude can process:
items: PDF documents (up to the context limit)

data.text: When you upload a document, Claude converts it into text that becomes part of the conversation context. The document content is 'injected' into Claude's working memory alongside your messages. This means Claude can reference specific pages, sections, or passages when answering your questions — but it can only reference what fits within the context window.

data.title: Things you can do with Claude and documents:
items: Summarize a 50-page PDF into 5 key bullet points
Extract all action items from meeting notes
Compare two versions of a contract and highlight differences
Explain a complex technical document in plain language
Generate study questions from a textbook chapter
Extract data from a spreadsheet and format it as a table
Rewrite a section of a document in a different tone

data.title: Document analysis prompt
data.content:
Upload a research paper PDF, then ask:

'Analyze this research paper. Provide: 1) The research question and hypothesis, 2) The methodology in plain language, 3) Key findings with specific data points, 4) Limitations acknowledged by the authors, 5) Three questions this research raises that future studies could explore.'

data.text: Claude's large context window means it can handle documents that would overwhelm most other assistants. A 200-page book, a comprehensive legal brief, or a detailed technical specification can all be uploaded and analyzed as a single unit. The key is to ask Claude to process it in stages — first summarizing sections, then synthesizing across the whole document.

data.title: Diagram: how Claude processes a long document
data.text: Imagine uploading a 300-page legal brief. Claude reads the entire document into its context window, then you can ask it to find all sections mentioning 'liability', summarize each chapter, compare arguments, and draft a memo — all in one conversation. This is fundamentally different from tools that can only search or summarize small chunks.

items.text: Upload a document and ask for a high-level summary first
items.hint: Get the big picture before diving into details

items.text: Ask Claude to extract specific data or sections
items.hint: Be explicit about what you need

items.text: Request a structured output — table, bullet points, or sections
Ask Claude to compare two uploaded documents
Validate Claude's extracted facts against the original document
items.hint: Especially important for legal, medical, or financial documents

data.title: Document understanding takeaways
points: Claude can read PDFs, Word docs, spreadsheets, and more
Uploaded documents become part of the conversation context
Use the 200K context window for large document analysis
Process in stages: summary first, details second
Always verify extracted facts against the original document
